'''Nouane''' was an [[Allied Region]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. A semi-independent government of 212 [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] located in the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]], Nouane was once a mini-[[Empire (disambiguation)|empire]], one of countless territories that existed during the early years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The region's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was also named [[Nouane/Legends|Nouane]].

After the nomadic [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[warrior]]s [[Battle of Nouane|attacked]] the planet Nouane in [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the Nouanese people petitioned the Republic for assistance. As a result, the region became an Allied Region affiliated with the Republic and governed by a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. Nouane held this distinction into the years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that replaced the Republic, and the region became a steadfast supporter of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] regime as an [[Imperial client state]]. When the Empire fell, Nouane chose to declare independence rather than become a member of the emerging [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
The semi-autonomous region of Nouane was located in the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. In the early years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Nouane was a thriving mini-[[Empire (disambiguation)|empire]], one of many such domains that could be found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Nouane/Legends|Nouane]], located in the [[Nouane system/Legends|system of the same name]].<ref name="Atlas" />

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Nouane joined the Republic as an [[Allied Region]], a semi-autonomous affiliate of the galactic government. By this time, the region came to possess 212 inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], including the [[Dwartii system/Legends|Dwartii system]]. The [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor/Legends|Vaathkree Trade Corridor]] ran through the northwestern part of the region.<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
The region of Nouane was one of countless thriving mini-empires that existed in the galaxy during the [[Expansionist Era|early years]] of the Republic, even before the systematic settlement of the Inner Rim. Its capital was the eponymous world of Nouane. The region&mdash;a beacon of civilization surrounded on all sides by then-unexplored space&mdash;was known to the Republic as early as [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]]. By this time, a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] ran from the planet Nouane to [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]], a world in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="Atlas" />

In the centuries following [[7000 BBY]], the Republic kept watch on the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans out of concern for Nouane and other areas of space.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> During the Mandalorian Wars of [[3976 BBY|3976]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]], however, the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] [[Battle of Nouane|attacked]] the planet Nouane, and the mini-empire turned to the Republic for assistance. Noaune was admitted into the Republic and reorganized into an [[Allied Region]], the name given to a semi-autonomous region of space allied with the galactic government. Leaders of Allied Regions typically held the title of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. As the centuries went by, the status of Allied Regions became largely ceremonial and the territories were gradually absorbed into the Republic as [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]; Nouane was one of the few to remain until the end of the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />

Over time, many of the Allied Region's worlds, scattered among 212 inhabited star systems, became well-known throughout the Republic. The planet Nouane, with its fabled libraries, became a destination of philosophers and artists from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]; additionally, its [[Minister/Legends|ministers]] could be found on numerous ambitious worlds within the Republic in high places of power. The [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]], from the Dwartii system, brought their coldly-merciless [[Politics/Legends|political]] philosophy to the Republic, where it was greatly contested and studied.<ref name="Atlas" />

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], centuries after Nouane joined it, the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Likewise, all of the remaining Allied Regions were reorganized into [[Imperial client state]]s. As one such client state, Nouane was fervently loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] new regime. However, when the Imperial government fell after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and was gradually replaced by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Nouane declared its independence. During Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Nouane was neutral.<ref name="Atlas" /> By [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the New Republic's [[Ferret-class reconnaissance vessel|reconnaissance vessel]] ''[[IX-26]]'' was on a patrol assignment in Nouane before it was diverted to the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology|Obroan Institute]] on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] to pick up an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] team to aid in the investigation surrounding the organic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] known as the [[Teljkon Vagabond]] and its frozen [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Brath Qella]].<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The region of Nouane was briefly mentioned in [[1996]]'s ''[[Before the Storm]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]]. The region received entries in [[1998]]'s ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', but it was not until [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' that Nouane was described in detail.
